functionalDefect.description: C01 approach and vertical circulation retain substandard clear envelopes; this blocks the controlled 5×5 approach, public common circulation, restricted owner return, and 3×3 BOH return.

safetyEnvelope.protectedCoreExclusion: No physical package may touch a container, block entity, protected tread, structural slab, decorative column, or unknown state. A reviewed exact migration may replace exclusion only for the explicitly inventoried service containers.
safetyEnvelope.entityRequirement: Fresh live-entity clearance remains mandatory immediately before a later physical mutation; this immutable design gate does not claim live entity clearance.

requiredInterfaces.responsibility: portal → L1 5×5 controlled spine and gravity boundary
public vertical, common nodes, protected switchback redesign
restricted owner vertical redesign and return
barrel migration or alternate staff bypass; no lost container contents

returnAndEgressRequirements: Two independently evidenced normal-walk returns are required for every altered route: the original portal ↔ L1 path and a separately owned emergency/alternate egress path that does not use the same stair flight, container aisle, or gravity-containment boundary.
The public and restricted routes require directed forward and inverse path proofs after each physical package; no route, public access, or commissioning claim follows from this design gate.
Every physical package must preserve the untouched route families and their access classifications through an immutable post-state route QA.
drainageAndContainment: Water, lava, bubble columns, waterlogged blocks, gravity blocks, and their receiver/overflow paths must be enumerated across the exact package interaction set before mutation.

The portal gravity boundary is not finite in this design envelope. Expand only from recorded boundary contacts, then use a supported permanent liner/plug or a separated dry bypass; inverse order must never recreate a falling or live-fluid path.
No drainage receiver or fluid diversion is accepted by inference. Any future receiver must have exact source/target/rollback states and its own finite overflow boundary.

firstPhysicalPackageCondition.permittedPurpose: A finite portal-approach gravity containment/liner or fully separated dry bypass only; it is not a widening, route opening, or access-class upgrade.
mustAllPass: The portal gravity components that touch the recorded safety-envelope boundary are expanded to a complete finite component inventory.

The exact package cell set, 1-cell interaction halo, all fluids/waterlogged states, gravity supports, receivers/overflows, block entities, protected-core exclusions, and source states are complete and canonical.
The package has a flow-ordered forward sequence and exact inverse that never creates a live-fluid or falling-gravity path; strict-noop forward and rollback parser checks pass.
Fresh live-entity clearance passes and the complete source is rebound immediately before mutation.
Both the original portal ↔ L1 return and an independent alternate/emergency return have accepted directed path proofs; all untouched C01 routes retain their required proofs.
The scoped runner journals mutation, captures a fresh immutable post snapshot, proves post containment/route preservation, and proves rollback against that post source.
explicitHardStops: Any unknown or boundary-touching fluid/gravity component
Any protected switchback/tread/decorative/structural cell in the physical interaction set

nonClaims: No operation files or release manifest emitted.
No RCON, Minecraft, fleet API, or live-world action.
No container migration, fluid/gravity containment, widening, route opening, access upgrade, public commissioning, or egress approval.
